title: Application to Study Permit Process Steps for Poland
notice: 1 EUR ≈ 120 BDT | 1 PLN ≈ 30 BDT (2026). Poland is a Schengen country — your National D Visa also allows travel across 27 Schengen countries.

processSteps.label: University Application : via university portal or study.gov.pl
bullets: Most universities have their own portal (e.g. apply.uw.edu.pl, rekrutacja.agh.edu.pl)
Application window: January–June for October intake
Some programs have no application fee; others charge €20–50

processSteps.label: Offer / Admission Letter
bullets: English-taught programs: tuition €2,000–€8,000/year (2.4–9.6 Lac BDT) depending on university and program
Polish-taught programs at state universities may be free or very low cost

processSteps.label: Prepare Financial Proof : ~60,000 PLN (~18,00,000 BDT) in bank
bullets: Shows ~5,000 PLN/month (~1,50,000 BDT) for one academic year
Bank statement must clearly show your name and balance
Sponsor's affidavit also accepted if funds belong to parents/guardian

processSteps.label: Book Student Housing / Dormitory
bullets: University dormitory (akademik): 500–1,000 PLN/month (~15,000–30,000 BDT)
Apply immediately after receiving admission — spots fill fast
Housing confirmation required for visa application

processSteps.label: Polish Embassy Dhaka — National D Visa Application
bullets: Book appointment online or by phone
Submit application form + all documents in person
Visa fee: €80 (~9,600 BDT) — paid at Embassy
Processing time: 3–8 weeks

processSteps.label: VFS Global / Biometrics (if required)
bullets: Polish Embassy Dhaka may direct applicants to VFS for biometrics
Check Embassy website for current biometrics procedure

processSteps.label: Arrive in Poland — Register for Temporary Residence Permit
bullets: Within 30 days of arrival, register your address at local Voivodeship (Urząd Wojewódzki)
Apply for Karta Pobytu (Residence Card) if staying beyond 90 days
Obtain PESEL (personal ID number) for banking and work

costSteps.label: Polish National D Visa Fee : €80 (~9,600 BDT) — paid at Embassy
VFS / Biometrics Service Fee (if applicable) : ~€20–30 (~2,400–3,600 BDT)
Financial Proof in Bank : ~60,000 PLN (~18,00,000 BDT) — your own money, not a fee
University Application Fee : €0–50 depending on university (~0–6,000 BDT)
Dormitory Deposit / First Month Rent : 500–2,500 PLN (~15,000–75,000 BDT)

resources.label: NAWA — Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange
